name: stocksense
description: StockSense — modular, ledger-first inventory management system

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.setup: npm run db:migrate -w server && npm run db:seed -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
